english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for mass communication channels and institutions, and can also refer generally to the media as an industry.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken term for the media, including newspapers and media organizations.

examples.english: The media report this news story all the time.
examples.traditional: 傳媒成日報道呢單新聞。

examples.english: The press keeps hounding us about that news story.
